source: District Administration Office, Rasuwa (Ministry of Home Affairs)
title: DAO Rasuwa — hospital treatment list (Rasuwa Hospital)
citation: DAO Rasuwa — Bhotekoshi flood treatment details
body: District Administration Office, Rasuwa published treatment details for flood-affected people at Rasuwa Hospital (PDF list through 12 Bhadra 2083). Official MoHA district page — bilingual site (नेपाली / EN). This site links to the page; we do not copy names.
